title: Slopper
description: A deliberately low-effort copper gear mod that turned out medium-effort.
body:
A deliberately low-effort copper gear mod that turned out to be medium-effort.

Adds a reasonably unique set of copper tools and a less-than-interesting set of copper armor. All copper items are repaired when struck by lightning and copper armor will protect you from lightning damage.

Also, mobs will occasionally spawn with copper gear - all mobs with copper armor and the occasional drowned with a copper shovel or sword.
